_metadata.description: CLI surface: status, routes, expose, lease, probe, audit, recover, and config commands, all emitting proto-typed --json output via cli-core.

requirements.title: Provide the full command set status/routes/expose/lease/probe/audit/recover/config
requirements.description: The CLI registers status, routes, expose, lease, probe, audit, recover, and config commands wired through cli-core/cliapp.ArgSchema to the corresponding API surfaces.

requirements.title: Emit proto-typed --json from every command
requirements.description: Every command accepts --json and emits a generated tunnel-manager proto message (snake_case, deterministic), so output is machine-parseable and contract-stable.

requirements.title: Expose and lease commands round-trip through the exposure API
requirements.description: tunnel-manager expose and lease (request/extend/revoke) drive the exposure broker over the API and return the resulting route/lease state in --json.
